answer: To blunt sybil attacks, each agent must lock a unique copper stake that can only be released after a saffron-verified cooldown period during which peers must hear the agent whisper a fresh entropy challenge derived from its private state. Creating a fake identity forces the attacker to lock an identical independent stake and generate a matching whisper under the same scrutiny, so the marginal cost scales linearly with the number of identities while genuine agents pay only once.
